sections.title: Entertainment Industry Knowledge Chatbots
sections.description: For Universal Pictures, Warner Bros., Netflix LA, and the entertainment studio community.

blocks.heading: Development and production knowledge chatbots
paragraphs: Self-hosted Llama 3 chatbots for studios' creative development teams — querying underlying rights databases, comparable title performance history, and production budget benchmarks for projects in active development. Studios will not use external API chatbots for proprietary development information — self-hosted is the standard.

blocks.heading: Business affairs research chatbots
paragraphs: RAG chatbots for studios' business affairs and legal departments — querying the complex rights chains, guild agreements, and licensing histories in natural language to support deal negotiation.

blocks.heading: Post-production support chatbots
paragraphs: Internal chatbots for post-production supervisors and VFX coordinators — querying bid history, vendor capabilities, and production workflow documentation.

sections.title: Multilingual Healthcare Chatbots
sections.description: For Cedars-Sinai, UCLA Health, and Kaiser Permanente SoCal's multilingual patient communities.

blocks.heading: Multilingual patient access chatbots
paragraphs: Appointment scheduling and symptom triage chatbots in Spanish, Chinese (Mandarin and Cantonese), Korean, Armenian, Farsi, and Tagalog for LA's extraordinarily diverse patient populations — the most linguistically diverse major US healthcare market outside New York.

blocks.heading: HIPAA + CCPA + CMIA compliant design
paragraphs: LA healthcare chatbots must comply with federal HIPAA requirements plus California's CCPA consumer privacy law and the California Medical Information Act's stricter-than-HIPAA medical information protections — ClickMasters designs LA healthcare chatbots with all three layers.

blocks.heading: Medicare and Medi-Cal navigation chatbots
paragraphs: Chatbots helping LA's large senior and Medicaid populations navigate coverage, benefits, and care access for the enormous Medi-Cal managed care programs serving LA County.

blocks.heading: Claims status chatbots

blocks.heading: Agent and broker support chatbots

sections.title: Los Angeles chatbot technical context
sections.description: Key technical and compliance considerations for Los Angeles chatbot deployments.

blocks.heading: CCPA compliance for all consumer chatbots
paragraphs: Every LA consumer chatbot that collects conversation data must comply with CCPA — consent disclosure, purpose limitation, and opt-out mechanisms are standard ClickMasters design requirements for LA consumer chatbots.

blocks.heading: SAG-AFTRA AI implications
paragraphs: Entertainment chatbots that could generate content using actor likenesses or voice patterns must be designed within current SAG-AFTRA AI provisions — ClickMasters designs entertainment chatbots for informational and administrative purposes that don't implicate performer AI rights.

blocks.heading: Multilingual as LA baseline
paragraphs: In a city where 40%+ of residents speak a language other than English at home, multilingual chatbot capability is a baseline expectation for consumer-facing applications rather than a premium add-on. ClickMasters designs LA consumer chatbots with Spanish as minimum standard, with Chinese, Korean, Armenian, and Tagalog as common additions.

items.question: Can ClickMasters build multilingual chatbots for Cedars-Sinai's diverse LA patient population?
items.answer: Yes — Spanish, Mandarin, Cantonese, Korean, Armenian, Farsi, and Tagalog patient navigation chatbots with HIPAA, CCPA, and CMIA compliance for Cedars-Sinai are ClickMasters capabilities.

items.question: Can ClickMasters build CCPA-compliant policy chatbots for Mercury Insurance?
items.answer: Yes — California Prop 103-aware insurance chatbots with CCPA data governance for Mercury's large California auto insurance customer base are ClickMasters capabilities.
